variants.name: loom-modelled protocol verified exhaustively
variants.idiom_name: loom::sync::atomic plus loom::model to explore every interleaving
variants.implementation_notes: The high-assurance form: write the protocol against loom's atomics and run it under loom::model, which explores every possible interleaving of a small state space and fails on any execution that violates the intended property. Far more reliable than reasoning about memory order by hand, and cheap for a two-variable protocol.
pitfalls: The state space explodes; model the protocol, not the application.
Tests run for a combinatorial time, so keep them tiny.
